scope_rationale: Five distinct spatial mechanisms absent from retained implementation; quad/oct dimensional transfer shares one exercise, and spatial-partition is assessed by explicit grid/hierarchy comparison rather than a duplicate sixth implementation.

competencies.outcome: Partition and lower-bound proof: Derive coordinate/ID partition, exact subtree bounds and positive weighted distance bound.
Construction and updates: Implement build/query/nearest and staged rebuild mutation; distinguish balance from dynamic logarithmic update.
Tie and refusal falsification: Reject equal-bound pruning and unweighted-metric mutants; preserve every refused output.
Changed metric and costs: Reconstruct three-dimensional weights and compare visits against an independent linear scan without a universal speed claim.
Conservative hierarchy proof: Derive2n-1 nodes, exact child unions and closed-boundary pruning.
Build and refit: Implement median-center build, copied ownership and bottom-up refit without altering child links.
Contact and stale ancestor diagnosis: Kill contact-exclusion and skipped-refit mutants; retain minimal moved-box evidence.
Changed geometry and costs: Compare refit with rebuild in3D and distinguish box candidates from physical shape intersection.
Ownership and termination: Derive half-open child ownership and depth5 for the chosen integer lattice.
Sparse construction and updates: Implement quad and octree children, unit duplicate buckets and transactional rebuild.
Boundary and capacity diagnosis: Kill omitted-low-child and dropped-duplicate controls; test-16,15 and rejected16.
Dimensional transfer: Reconstruct eight-child ownership, sparse space use and exact exhausted budget with independent queries.
Occupancy and search proof: Derive minimum/maximum entries, equal leaf depth, exact bounds and all-branch search.
Split and deletion construction: Implement recursive split propagation and staged flatten/reinsert condensation, documenting its difference from original level-preserving reinsertion.
Lost branch and orphan diagnosis: Kill first-branch-only and dropped-orphan mutants; refuse capacity without publishing a partial split.
Changed dimensional updates: Use3D overlapping boxes, root collapse and volume ties; account for worst-case traversal and reinsertion costs.
Cell and candidate proof: Derive signed floor, closed endpoint mapping, full-cell equality and deduplicated pair completeness.
Construction and ownership: Implement bounded reference lists and complete preflight for every replicated box; preserve old index on exhaustion.
Negative coordinates and duplicates: Kill truncation and repeated-pair controls; demonstrate same-cell disjoint boxes and collisions without false contact.
Partition comparison and transfer: Change width and dimension, compare replication/visits with BVH under identical geometry and explain large-object resource refusal.
